topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Finding those flowers on my doorstep this morning, I felt the day bloom a little brighter. No card, no note, just a vibrant bunch of tulips swaying gently in the morning breeze. I couldn’t help but trace the petals, their softness a soothing contrast to the usual brisk start of my days. It made me wonder, who took the time to think of me so kindly? The anonymity of the gesture only added a touch of mystery, a gentle whisper of thoughtfulness that felt like a breath of fresh air. Setting them in a vase by the window, I found myself smiling more often, the question lingering, yet the warmth of the gesture overshadowing any curiosity. Each glance at those flowers felt like a silent reminder of the unexpected joys in life.
